subject: reasoning
question: J is the mother of K. K is the father of L. M is the son of J. How is M related to L?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) J is the mother of K.

2) K is the father of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8be57c1fb02c4bb0f13e6c2dad198cf3687e6ff4e38b92d6c71872d483c59cb8.png] 

3) M is the son of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ef2a48d4e5e038d86caf3945bad552edf8b9a9ad656d8a8874c86ea41b1570.png] 

Thus, M is L's uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
